1992|05f55f8a.name: Tarindrella
1992|05f55f8a.text: Only in Nature do we find purity.

2079|26ba7149.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
2079|26ba7149.text: Ah, the beauty of Shadowglen never ceases to delight my senses!

2080|ac9bd966.name: Denalan
2080|ac9bd966.text: The creation of Teldrassil was a grand achievement, but now the world must shift to regain its balance.

267287|83e0509a.name: Sylassa Moonglow
267287|83e0509a.text:
Hello, $N! Have you considered taking up a tradeskill?

I would be happy to answer any questions you might have, or point you toward the local trainers.

If this feels overwhelming, that's okay! You can always return here or visit trainers in capital cities to get started on your crafting journey at any time.

267287|b3334d4d.name: Sylassa Moonglow
267287|b3334d4d.text:
Of course! Which profession would you like me to guide you towards?

I will mark your map with the location of a local trainer of your choice. Remember that you can visit trainers in capital cities for more thorough training.

267287|e9b56518.name: Sylassa Moonglow
267287|e9b56518.text: Great choice. I have marked that location on your map.

267333|0371bf6f.name: Terunne Bearshaper
267333|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

3567|0e584820.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
3567|0e584820.text: Well met, $N. It is good to see that druids like yourself are taking an active part in protecting the groves.

3571|09c11794.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|09c11794.text: The Maneweavers practice their professions out of their home on the road to Darnassus.  Nadyia is an excellent teacher when it comes to Leatherworking.  You should see what she can teach you.

3571|2a249ced.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|2a249ced.text: You will find numerous trainers around Dolanaar with ages of experience with which to tutor you.  Which would you have me point you to?

3571|2e951586.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|2e951586.text: Nadyia has made quite the leatherworker in her years of practice.  Travel west on the road to Darnassus to pay her a visit and maybe she can bestow some of her knowledge upon you.

3571|497f7ea2.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|497f7ea2.text: There are many places that you might visit in Teldrassil.  Tell me what you seek.

3571|75932d8c.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|75932d8c.text: The Timberlings have made it too difficult for the fishermen to catch anything around Dolanaar.  You best look for someone to train you in Darnassus.

3571|bd8fa617.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|bd8fa617.text: You can find Radnaal practicing his craft outside his home on the road to Darnassus.  You should stop by and see what he can teach you.

3571|d62c00ae.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|d62c00ae.text: All the fisherman have moved to Darnassus with the recent attacks around Lake Al'Ameth.  You should try looking for someone to train you there.

3571|f844e66a.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|f844e66a.text: The path of those who undertake a profession is long and rewarding.  Which path do you choose to walk?

3593|c8e02354.name: Alyissia
3593|c8e02354.text: I do not see the warrior's spirit within you, child.  I have no teachings which would benefit a $c such as yourself.

3594|d3ecaafb.name: Frahun Shadewhisper
3594|d3ecaafb.text: We are but darkness and shadows. Eternal. Invisible.

3596|f9b860f0.name: Ayanna Everstride
3596|f9b860f0.text: I cannot train a $c such as yourself.

3597|e653c173.name: Mardant Strongoak
3597|e653c173.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

3602|61371b1a.name: Kal
3602|61371b1a.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

We are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Malfurion lies in the Dreaming.  Never forget this.

3605|08c2dba0.name: Nadyia Maneweaver
3605|08c2dba0.text: You need to make your stitches smaller, $N. Fewer items will slip out of your quivers and ammo pouches. Besides, no one likes a lumpy tunic.

3605|c7a4e3ad.name: Nadyia Maneweaver
3605|c7a4e3ad.text: Welcome to our home, $N. Radnaal and I have little to offer, but you are welcome to what hospitality we can provide.

6094|a28d29e1.name: Byancie
6094|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6286|f842f7e5.name: Zarrin
6286|f842f7e5.text: Hello, $N. If you'd like to learn a thing or two about cooking, please visit me at any time.

6736|41276936.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
6736|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

490-accept.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-accept.text:
By strict orders from the Sentinels, I am commissioning a bounty on the Gnarlpine. They are no longer friends of the forest. Their corruption has left them mindless threats to our people and the creatures of the glade.

As decreed, you shall be rewarded for removing the furbolg menaces from Teldrassil. Bring to me their fangs as proof of your deeds.

You will find furbolg concentrated in Ban'ethil Hollow, west of Dolanaar and south of the road, and in Starbreeze Village to the east.
490-accept.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

490-complete.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-complete.text: You have served well, $N. You shall be rewarded for your contribution.
490-complete.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

490-progress.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-progress.text: Teldrassil cannot thrive with corruption tainting the land. Drive the Gnarlpine from this forest, once and for all.
490-progress.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

96630-accept.name: Unknown
96630-accept.text:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96630-accept.title: The Adventurer

97946-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
97946-accept.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97946-accept.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97946-complete.name: Nadyia Maneweaver
97946-complete.text:
There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97946-complete.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97949-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
97949-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97949-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97949-complete.name: Radnaal Maneweaver
97949-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97949-complete.title: Camping 101: Skinning
